headline: Nigeria Domestic Airline Capacity Drops Below 1 Million Seats in November
summary: Scheduled domestic airline seat capacity in Nigeria fell to 978,000 in November 2026, down from over 1 million in October. Despite the monthly drop, total seat capacity grew on a year-over-year basis.
why: Domestic passenger seat availability reflects commercial aviation fuel availability, airline fleet maintenance, and overall domestic economic activity.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Seasonal or operational decreases in available seat capacity constrain passenger throughput.
